lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular 2D grid matrix.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of blobs, creating visible anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal features running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition (high-intensity highlight above, low-intensity shadow below).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Distribution of ~8-12 high-luminance blobs visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, concentrated primarily toward the anterior base and lower mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent concave notch/irregularity on the posterior trailing edge of the extended pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition from high-frequency punctate pattern on the rostrum to larger discrete maculae at the cranial-trunk boundary; multiple lower-luminance elongated shapes (remoras) visible on the ventral surface.
